title: Branches leak past branch cleanup: re-pushed spent branches, an unreachable sweep tail, and no-PR branches
problem: The remote holds 1,465 branches although `delete_branch_on_merge` is on and the branch-cleanup workflow runs green, so `git branch -r` (what a session reads to see existing work) is mostly noise again. Three leaks: (1) sessions reset to origin/main after a merge and push again, recreating the deleted branch at main's own squash commit, which branch_cleanup.py then keeps forever as 'has moved'; (2) the sweep's 500 live-head window filled with those kept branches and its 5,000-row scan stopped short of ~6,800 closed PRs, so old closed-unmerged branches were never reached; (3) nothing deletes branches that never had a PR, even when their tip is already in main.
evidence: GitHub API, 2026-10-16: 1,465 remote branches; delete_branch_on_merge true; branch-cleanup.yml runs green
872 of 875 surviving merged-PR branches have a tip past the PR head; 682 of those tips are already contained in main (compare ahead_by 0)
59 branches of PRs closed unmerged more than 24h ago still sit at their PR head; ~6,800 closed PRs vs DEFAULT_SWEEP_SCAN 5000 and DEFAULT_MAX_PRS 500
415 branches never had a PR; 285 of them have tips already in main
change: branch_cleanup.py: delete a moved branch whose tip is an ancestor of main (main's recent commit list, else compare main...tip ahead_by == 0); sweep every closed PR (scan cap 50,000) and also delete no-PR branches whose tip is in main and over 48h old; never a branch with commits not in main, an open PR, or a protected name; bound each run by --max-deletes 200 and --compare-budget 200 instead of the PR window. land-your-work.md: never push a branch that holds nothing beyond main. unlanded_work.py notes a pushed branch whose tip is already in main.
metric: Remote branch count, and branches whose tip is already in main, a week after the change lands
baseline: 1,465 branches; ~1,038 deletable (682 merged-moved-contained + 71 closed-contained + 285 no-PR-contained); 322 with unique commits left for adopt-stranded
source: branch-hygiene investigation via the GitHub API, 2026-10-16
